title: Personalized Basketball Below Hoop Comforter with Name and Number Design 2
description:
Brighten up your bedroom with this custom-designed sport bedding, perfect for basketball players and fans alike. This personalized set brings a vibrant athletic vibe to any space while keeping you cozy all year round.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customize with your own chosen Name and Number for a truly unique, one-of-a-kind sports bedding piece.
  • Premium Material: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester fabric that is soft, durable, and lightweight, featuring a whole-piece microfiber filling with tight stitching to prevent clumping.
  • FADE-RESISTANT COLOR: Our advanced manufacturing and environmental protection techniques allow the fabric to hold onto dyes, preventing fading over time.
  • EASY CARE: Fully machine washable in cold water. Dries quickly and fluffs up beautifully after air drying.
  • VERSATILE SIZE OPTIONS: Available in several sizes, including US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88").

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Cotton/ Polyester
Color Basketball D19
Pattern Basketball Print
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
